protocol: From-scratch output-form control: identical full60000 actual batch streams,128D, seed, exact data/splits, raw unit-cost labels, losses, budget and validation selector. Each selected checkpoint is evaluated frozen with diagnostic source437779b, without action pruning or search. Different best steps are a result of the same validation selector; same-step15000 comparison is separate.

stream_identity.meaning: Every actual point source/goal, ranking source/goal, legal candidate, raw true distance, reachability and optimal mask is elementwise identical across the complete60000-step output-activation control. This checks actual records, not only sampler quotas.

actual_exposure.counter_semantics: State inputs participating in loss computation, not proven nonzero gradients. Source-row coverage is a draw count.

bellman.note: Reference decisions, not whole trajectories. Unit-cost teacher-optimal edges should have a true remaining-distance drop of1. Candidate order can be correct even when the parent-to-child predicted drop is wrong. No oracle is used to change model action selection.
